Saved Views is available today for all customers on paid plans. Now you can save your preferred filters, sorting, and grouping for any list, then return to that exact setup in a single click, without rebuilding it every time you open a project.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so you can create dedicated setups for sprints, priorities, clients, or teams without worrying about running out of room. Views can also be shared with your team, making it easy to give everyone the same perspective on a project: a manager's timeline view, a developer's board sorted by priority, or a support view filtered by open tickets.

Saved Views works across every list in your workspace and updates automatically as your underlying data changes, so shared views always stay current for the whole team. No more re-applying the same filters every morning or explaining to a teammate how to recreate your setup.

We built this feature based on direct feedback from customers who wanted faster, simpler ways to organize and reuse their favorite configurations.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
